description: Net LHV efficiency as f(PLR, T_amb) for coal IGCC plant. Gasifier + syngas cleanup + CCGT block. Syngas LHV and CO2 intensity included. Carbon-capture-ready configuration.

unit.name: Generic 400 MW Coal IGCC (GE/Texaco-type entrained-flow gasifier)
unit.source: Cormos, C.-C. (2012). Evaluation of energy integration aspects for IGCC-based hydrogen production with CO2 capture and storage. Int. J. Hydrogen Energy, 37(4), 3083-3095; IEA GHG R&D Programme (2003). Potential for improvements in gasification combined cycle power generation with CO2 capture; Booras & Holt (2004), EPRI.

eta_iso.note: Net LHV efficiency at rated load (typical IGCC 40-45%); PLR=1, T_amb=15C

k_amb.note: Ambient derating; larger than PC due to gas turbine component (~0.4%/K)

a0.note: IGCC has flatter minimum load floor due to gasifier turndown limits

syngas_lhv.note: Syngas LHV after cleanup; range 10-12 MJ/Nm3 for coal syngas (H2+CO mix)

gasifier_cold_gas_efficiency.note: Fraction of coal LHV transferred to syngas (cold-gas efficiency); typical 78-83%

min_plr.note: Higher minimum PLR than PC due to gasifier turndown constraints
